Welspun Projects Limited (2010―2014) | type = [[Public company|Public]] | traded_as = {{ubl|{{NSE|WELENT}}|{{BSE|532553}}}} | ISIN = {{ISIN|INE625G01013}} | industry = {{Unbulleted list|[[Construction]]|[[Engineering]]|[[Public utility|Utilities]] ([[energy industry|energy]])}} | founded = 1976 | area_served = India | key_people = {{ubl|Balkrishan Goenka (Chairman)|Sandeep Garg (Managing Director)|Rajesh R. Mandawewala (Director)}} | parent = Welspun World | website = }} '''Welspun Enterprises Limited''' ('''WEL''') is an Indian company that develops and operates [[roads]], [[highways]], and [[wastewater]] projects under various [[public–private partnership]] (PPP) models in rural and urban areas.{{Cite web |last=Ksheerasagar |first=A |title=Multibagger Welspun Enterprises stock jumps over 6.5% on ₹1,864-crore order win |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/multibagger-welspun-enterprises-stock-jumps-over-6-5-on-rs-1-864-crore-order-win-11716373818218.html}} The company is also involved in the [[oil]] and [[gas exploration]] sector through a joint venture with [[Adani Group|Adani]] Welspun Exploration Limited.{{Cite web |title=Welspun Enterprises Ltd. |url=https://www.hdfcsec.com/hsl.research.pdf/HSL_Stock%20Note%20Welspun%20Enterprises-%20July%202023_Upload.pdf |website=HDFC Securities}} == History == === MSK Projects (India) Limited === The company began its construction operations in 1976 as a partnership firm under the name M. S. Khurana. In 2004, it became a publicly listed entity with shares listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE), [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE), and [[Vadodara Stock Exchange]] (VSE). In 2006, the company launched a joint venture, BUL MSK Infrastructure, to manage toll collection for the Dand Apta Kharpada and Kon Sawle Road Project. In 2010, it was renamed from MSK Projects (India) Ltd.{{Cite web |last=Rebello |first=Joel |title=Welspun-Gujarat unit to acquire MSK Projects |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/RjgdDAzqZNcBS9Hd0VPuVL/WelspunGujarat-unit-to-acquire-MSK-Projects.html}} to Welspun Projects Ltd. (WPL) and expanded into the energy sector.{{Cite web |title=How much is Welspun Infratech planning to raise through private equity placement for future developments? |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/quiz-how-much-is-welspun-infratech-planning-to-raise-through-private-equity-placement-for-future-developments-1560281 |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=www.dnaindia.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Welspun Arm Buys Majority Stake In Construction Firm |url=https://www.vccircle.com/welspun-arm-buys-majority-stake-construction-firm |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}} The company acquired a majority stake in the Aziz European Pipe factory in [[Saudi Arabia]].{{Cite news |date=2010-04-05 |title=Welspun eyes stake in Saudi co |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/welspun-eyes-stake-in-saudi-co/articleshow/5761211.cms |access-date=2024-10-14 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} In 2011, it acquired a 35% stake in [[CIMIC Group|Leighton Contractors]] (India){{Cite web |title=Welspun Infra Picks Up 35% In Leighton For Rs 470Cr |url=https://www.vccircle.com/welspun-infra-picks-35-leighton-rs-470cr |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}} and established a new 350,000 MTPA LSAW plant in [[Anjar, Gujarat|Anjar]].{{Cite web |title=Welspun Anjar plant to begin production in Dec |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/welspun-anjar-plant-to-begin-production-in-dec-104111601048_1.html}} Between 2012 and 2013, it completed several major construction projects, including Anjar Township, Bhilai Township, and Umergam Water Distribution.{{Cite web |title=Welspun Enterp Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/welspun-enterprises-ltd/summary |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=India Infoline |language=en}} === Formation of Welspun Enterprises Limited === As part of the Welspun Group's infrastructure investment restructuring, a significant portion of WPL's EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) business was transferred to Leighton Welspun Contractors Private Limited (LWIN) in 2013.{{Cite web |title=Welspun Projects to sell 72% EPC order book to Leighton Welspun for $20.8M |url=https://www.vccircle.com/welspun-projects-sell-72-epc-order-book-leighton-welspun-208m |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}} This transfer included WPL's water business and other EPC contracts, in exchange for a 7.5% equity stake in LWIN. The company also completed six [[build–operate–transfer]] (BOT) road projects covering over 500 km with a capital expenditure exceeding US$200 million.{{Cite news |date=2022-12-23 |title=Welspun sells 6 highway projects to PE firm Actis |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/welspun-sells-6-highway-projects-to-pe-firm-actis/articleshow/96435210.cms |access-date=2024-10-14 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} It was among the first developers to complete a [[National Highways Authority of India]] (NHAI) BOT project in India. In 2014, the Welspun Group decided to merge three of its units; Welspun Infratech Ltd, Welspun Plastics Pvt. Ltd, and Welspun Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd, with Welspun Projects Ltd to streamline its corporate structure and consolidate its balance sheet. The merged entity was named Welspun Enterprises.{{Cite web |last=Sharma |first=Shailaja |title=Welspun Enterprises divests 37% stake in Dewas Bhopal road project |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/g36muiHY1EUVEwxMHsi5yK/Welspun-Enterprises-divests-37-stake-in-Dewas-Bhopal-road-p.html |website=MINT}}{{Cite web |title=Welspun Corp demerges unit |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/welspun-corp-demerges-unit-113060300138_1.html}} === Projects === '''Welspun Enterprises''' completed its first project, the [[Delhi–Meerut Expressway|Delhi-Meerut Expressway]] (Package I), in 2018, the first 14-lane expressway in India.{{Cite web |date=2016-09-12 |title=Welspun Enterprises closes financing of India's first express way project |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/in-a-first-welspun-ties-funds-for-road-project-under-hybrid-annuity-model/article9100268.ece |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2018-05-28 |title=Delhi-Meerut Expressway: This stock hit its lifetime high a day after inauguration |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/company-stock/story/delhi-meerut-expressway-opens-narendra-modi-nitin-gadkari-106251-2018-05-28 |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=Business Today |language=en}} In 2022, the company announced that the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) issued a Provisional Certificate for Commercial Operation (PCOD) for 53.763 km (77.96%) of the total project length of 68.960 km. This certificate related to the 8-laning of the section of NH-1 (New NH-44) from [[Magenta Line (Delhi Metro)|Mukarba Chowk]] to [[Panipat]] on a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) (Toll) basis.{{Cite web |title=Welspun Enterprises stock zooms 6% on receiving provisional certificate for commercial operation of NHAI project |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/news/markets/welspun-enterprises-stock-zooms-6-on-receiving-provisional-certificate-for-commercial-operation-of-nhai-project |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=www.indiainfoline.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2024-06-06 |title=Welspun Enterprises settles dispute with Indian Oil Corp, to receive ₹23.67 crore - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/welspun-enterprises-settles-dispute-with-indian-oil-corp-19424830.htm |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}} The company divested its entire 15.49% stake in [[Welspun Energy]].{{Cite web |title=Opening bell: Asian markets open mixed; ICICI Bank, Maruti in news |url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/B35nhu6415g3HJwRPNtfiJ/Opening-bell-Asian-markets-open-mixed-ICICI-Bank-Maruti.html |website=Mint (newspapwr)}} It also sold a 37% stake in its Dewas-Bhopal corridor project to an infrastructure fund managed by IDFC Alternatives for Rs 662 crore. Welspun Enterprises initially held a 50% stake in the 142.6 km Dewas-Bhopal Corridor Pvt. Ltd. (DBCL), with the remaining stake held by Chetak Enterprises Ltd., a highways developer. Following the sale, Welspun Enterprises now holds a 13% stake in the project.{{Cite web |title=Welspun sells 37% stake in road project to IDFC fund |url=https://www.vccircle.com/welspun-sells-37-stake-road-project-idfc-fund |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}} Currently, the company is involved in executing several projects, including the Rural Water Supply Project under the Government of India's [[Jal Jeevan Mission]] in [[Uttar Pradesh]], covering 2,500 villages.{{Cite web |date=2024-03-01 |title=Welspun Enterprises secures new order for 2000 MLD Water Treatment Plant worth Rs 4,123.88 crore from BMC |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-welspun-enterprises-secures-new-order-for-2000-mld-water-treatment-plant-worth-rs-4123-88-crore-from-bmc-3410385/ |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=Financialexpress |language=en}} In March 2024, Welspun Enterprises was commissioned by the [[Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation]] (BMC) to design, build, and operate a 2,000 MLD (million liters per day) [[Water treatment|Water Treatment Plant]] (WTP) at the Bhandup Complex in [[Mumbai]].{{Cite news |title=Welspun secures Rs 4,123 crore order from BMC for water treatment plant |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/welspun-secures-rs-4-123-crore-order-from-bmc-for-water-treatment-plant-124030100199_1.html |work=Business Standard}} The company was also commissioned to construct an Access Controlled Multi-Modal Corridor from [[Navghar]] to Balavali in the state of [[Maharashtra]] on EPC Mode Package MMC-11, covering the stretch from Kalambsure (km 88+620) to Govirle (km 96+410) in Tq. Uran & District Raigad (length - 7.79 km) for the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation.{{Cite web |date=2024-05-22 |title=Welspun Enterprises lowest bidder for ₹1,864 crore project in Maharashtra; Stock surges 8% - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/welspun-enterprises-share-price-lowest-bidder-maharashtra-project-stock-reaction-multi-modal-corridor-19415718.htm |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en}} == Partnerships, acquisitions and subsidiaries == In 2020, Welspun Enterprises acquired a build-operate-transfer (BOT) toll project from [[Essel Group]]'s company, Mukarba Chowk-Panipat Toll Roads (MCPTRL).{{Cite web |title=Welspun Enterprises to acquire toll road project from Essel Group |url=https://www.vccircle.com/welspun-enterprises-to-acquire-toll-road-project-from-essel-group |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}} The company also signed a pact with the [[National Highways Authority of India]] (NHAI) for a Rs 20.05 billion highway project in [[Tamil Nadu]].{{Cite news |last=Babar |first=Kailash |last2=Khan |first2=Sobia |date=2024-01-08 |title=Welspun One inks Rs 2,000-cr investment pact with Tamil Nadu government |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/property-/-cstruction/welspun-one-inks-rs-2000-cr-investment-pact-with-tamil-nadu-government/articleshow/106642888.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-10-14 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}{{Cite web |title=Welspun One inks pact with TN, proposes Rs 20 billion investment |url=https://www.constructionworld.in/policy-updates-and-economic-news/welspun-one-inks-pact-with-tn--proposes-rs-20-billion-investment/50429 |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=www.constructionworld.in |language=en}} In December 2022, the company sold six highway projects to [[Actis Capital|Actis]], a [[London]]-based global investment firm, for $775 million.{{Cite web |title=Actis buys Welspun's six road projects for $775 mn |url=https://www.vccircle.com/actis-buys-welspun-s-six-road-projects-for-775-mn |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=VCCircle |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |date=2022-06-10 |title=Welspun Enterprises sells road assets to Actis for ₹6,000 crore |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/enterprise/welspun-enterprises-sells-road-assets-to-actis-for-6000-crore/108550 |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=www.fortuneindia.com |language=en}} In August 2023, the company announced that it had acquired a 50.10% stake in Michigan Engineers, an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company in the urban water infrastructure segment, for Rs.137.07 crore.{{Cite news |last=Pathak |first=Kalpana |date=2023-08-21 |title=Welspun Enterprises acquires 50.10% stake in Michigan Engineers for Rs 137 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/construction/welspun-enterprises-acquires-50-10-stake-in-michigan-engineers-for-rs-137-crore/articleshow/102912960.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-10-14 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} WEL acquired a 36.05% stake from Authum Investment & Infrastructure and a 14.05% stake from Sansaar Housing Finance. With this acquisition, Michigan Engineers became a subsidiary of WEL.{{Cite web |title=Welspun Enterprises completes 50.10% stake buy in Michigan Engineers for equity investment of Rs 137.1 crore |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/welspun-enterprises-acquires-50-10-in-michigan-engineers-for-equity-investment-of-rs-137-1-crore-11231761.html}}{{Cite web |title=Income tax department searches Welspun Enterprises premises |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/nuh4pb8IqzWpKGRtRWSuKN/Income-tax-dept-searches-at-Welspun-Enterprises-premises.html}} == References == {{Reflist}} == External links == * [https://www.welspunenterprises.com Welspun Enterprises] — official website [[Category:Construction and civil engineering companies of India]] [[Category:Companies established in 1976]] [[Category:Engineering companies of India]]
extract: Welspun Enterprises Limited (WEL) is an Indian company that develops and operates roads, highways, and wastewater projects under various public–private partnership (PPP) models in rural and urban areas. The company is also involved in the oil and gas exploration sector through a joint venture with Adani Welspun Exploration Limited.
